topic: Identifying suitable German traffic data sources
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on identifying comparable German box data for two specific campaigns (JCD_DE_120804 and JCD_DE_120848). [p1] initially suggested boxes 637 and 897 based on behavioral similarity, providing a document link detailing traffic levels (low/average).
[me] clarified that the requirement was for data categorized by type or location rather than just absolute values.
It was determined that someone else (Nastia) is better equipped to assist with location-based data sourcing.
decisions: The source of location-specific German box data should be coordinated through Nastia.
action_items: Follow up with Nastia regarding suitable German box data for campaign analysis.
